title: Solving polynomial inequalities over spaces of convex sets and applications
summary: We develop a symbolic elimination theory for finite systems of recursive containment inequalities whose unknowns are convex subsets of a finite-dimensional real vector space. The right-hand sides are formal expressions generated from variables and parameters by convex linear combinations, finite union, and a positive geometric join encoding strict convex combinations.
